reviews.text: If I had known the doctor I trusted for over 10 years had retired, I would not have made the trip. Unfortunately, after today’s experience, I can say with certainty that I will not be returning. The new doctor did not provide the level of care or attention I expected, and the prices have also increased significantly. Very disappointing experience after so many years.
The veterinarians here are very thorough and have taken care of my puppies vaccinations, prices are reasonable!

People do not bring your pets here. I brought one of my cats here for the past 13 years only drew blood one time and told me that my cat had a UTI. Took him year after year never re-drew blood. My cat would throw up and visit after visit he was prescribed a hairball medicine which never worked. This Vet is not good at all. Never checked on my cat at every visit. Had to finally take my Cat to another pet clinic and my cat was diagnosed with Stage 3 Kidney Disease. My cat got worse and I had to put him down Saturday 9/26. Had this female Vet had done more perhaps my cat still be alive. I'm not leaving this like this.

They give good attention
They do a great job caring for pets. Been coming here for years.
Busy and affordable

I am beyond angry, hurt, and disappointed with North Loop Pet Clinic.

I left my baby in your care on July 21 to be cremated. Today is August 11, and I have now learned that she is STILL there, in a freezer. I cannot understand how this could happen. How does a beloved pet who was entrusted to you for cremation remain there for three weeks? Was she forgotten?

She was not “just a dog” to me. She was my baby, a member of my family, and I trusted you to treat her with dignity and respect after her passing.

Now my mind is filled with questions I never should have had to ask. How do I know she is still there? How do I know for certain that the remains you eventually return to me will actually be hers? What happened after I left her with you on July 21? Why wasn’t she sent for cremation? Why wasn’t I contacted?

I am so upset that I honestly do not trust myself to have this conversation verbally right now. I am grieving, and finding this out has added another layer of pain to something that was already heartbreaking.

I need answers. I need an explanation of exactly what happened, where my baby has been since July 21, and what will be done to ensure that she is properly identified and that the ashes returned to me are hers.

I trusted you with my baby during one of the hardest moments a pet owner goes through. I should never have been left wondering if she was forgotten in a freezer.

I am heartbroken. 💔🐾

It’s a low-cost vet clinic, so you have to arrive early, as there is usually a line of cars waiting outside before the clinic opens. Today, I found out that although their website states that they’re open on Saturdays, they are apparently only open every other Saturday.

It would be helpful if they had a sign or some type of notice at the entrance informing people of the Saturday schedule, so they don’t have to sit outside for hours waiting for the gate to open, only to find out that the clinic is closed.

I've been bringing my fur babies (dogs and cats)to Dr.Mares for over 14 years now. Dr. Mares and her entire staff are amazing! They are extremely knowledgeable and they work very quickly. And the cost is so affordable. I drive over 30 min to get there. You have to get there early to wait in line. But it's so worth it bcz we all know how expensive vet bills can be. I will continue to bring my fur babies here. Thank you Dr. Mares and thank you to all her staff for all that you do! 🙏😊🙏

They have good prices, they serve you in English and Spanish, you don't need an appointment, you arrive, register, and wait in your car. They call you when it's your turn. The wait can take up to an hour, so you have to be prepared with water for the pets and anything else they need to be comfortable. Only one person is allowed in the waiting room with the pets. I've been taking my pets there for years, and everything has been fine; I've never had any problems.
Fast and great customer service
Good price, very good staff, good service

If you have time to potentially wait this is a good choice.  I would say plan to wait at least an hour with your pet in your car. If you pull onto the back street you will have the time and space to walk your pet if needed. From my experiences here you go and sign in by name and phone number. You go back to your car, and then they call you when you're up next. Its a pretty smooth process since most people walk in and then go to their car to wait. All of the staff were extremely polite. The vets were knowledge, competent,  and showed concern. There prices are probably the best you will find. Parking is limited.

My sweet cat Pooh was having some cough hacking fits last night, which I suspected it to be asthma. I went straight there this morning as I was worried that it could be something else. The staff took great care of us, and everyone was very kind and attentive. My Pooh does have asthma after a formal diagnosis, so they gave him steroids. He got X-ray, physical exam, a fecal test, his vaccines and rabies shots, and steroids for a very good price!! I’ll definitely bring Pooh back again and start my other two cats as well.
